about: Known disagreements between the game files (maplestory.io MCW) and the MapleStory Classic Wiki. Our data keeps the game's value; the weekly fact check lists these under 'unconfirmed' instead of failing. Add an entry once a new disagreement has been looked at; remove it when the sources agree again. ignore_new: source entries that look new but are not released content.
